'''System Patrol Squadrons''' were units within the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], they patrolled the areas around the astronomical object [[Farfeld II]] and<ref name="B-wing">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Tour of Duty: B-Wing]]''</ref> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|258|Feenicks VI}}</ref> [[Feenicks VI]].<ref name="B-wing" />
